text: Search Library Collections – Central Library Skip to main content Skip to footer Opens in a new tab University of Sulaimani Central Library Home About About the Library Staff of the Library Library Map Koha/Opac Services Printing Service Rules Activities Contact Search Library Collections Home » Search Library Collections How to Search Library Collections Users can search library collections via OPAC: C-library.univsul.edu.iq Users can search items either by Author, Title, Subject, Call no. or ISBN. Periodicals, Theses, and items which printed in France, Germany, Italian, Russian, languages not available in OPAC yet. Users should use UNICODE, for Kurdish items use c-for Kurd, Arabic Jordan, for Arabic Items, use Arabic Saudia All Members of Sulaimani University can get Library Card To apply a library card, please bring the following documents: Member card of Sulaimani University Your ID and passport Each registered person receives a library card issued in her/his name. The card is not transferable. By signing the library card, the user agree to the regulations for use provided at registration. User information is saved electronically for internal use in accordance with data privacy laws. Losing your Library Card Please contact the Circulation Department immediately to block your account if you lose your library card. Until your account is blocked, you are responsible for any misuse of your library card. Please also contact the Circulation Department if your name or address changes.
